item.title: The Wild Hunt
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mythology

Page Layout: towards the bottom of the full article, I plan on having a series of procedures for luring people indoors away from the storm with some discontinued due to not having the desired effect or being too impractical

Elevator Pitch: based around the core mythology of the Wild Hunt a group of knights lead by a king that appear during extremely powerful storms.
Amy male 12 years or older outside during the height of the storm fall under a kind of mind control, 'willingly' joining the Wild Hunt.

Central Narrative:

+ Show
- Hide

• disappearances across arctic and polar regions have been tracked, dating back years, connected to high power storms in said regions
• team is dispatched in front of high-powered storm, isolated from settlements (team receded incident in full)
• at height of storm the weather parts and an aroura borealis appears with Knights, Yeomen, Footmen and hounds seen running in the lights in the same direction as the storm is moving
• a king appeared and stopped above them, waving them to join
• In the forest below the king can be seen a glow and the team walk off towards it.
• the storm returns soon after with the team listed as MIA
• second test involved a D-class with eyewear to counter any magic effect on D-class
• same as before the Wild Hunt appears running along the aroura in the same direction of the storm.
• the king appears and states he is insulted a peasant would not bow before their king
• the D-class proceeds to use a large amount of profanity against the king for calling him a peasant
• the king shouted is anger at the D-class with a thunderous boom and pointed his weapon at the D-class
• in the tree line a number of large hounds with white fur and red tipped ears can be seen appearing along with two knights on skeletal steeds with rusted horse armour and mounted knights with equally worn armour. both rider and horse had a glowing blue mist from their eye sockets/helmet
• the D-class is seen running away with the camera trampled in pursuit
• partial remains were recovered of D-class.
• third attempt involved a rouge scientist utilising same glasses but bowed when the storm broke and the aroura appeared
• the king appeared and welcomed him to rise and join the Hunt with the scientist humbly requesting the king to remain, stating he is the only one left to care for his household
• the king and scientist spoke for an elapsed 5 min 13.5 seconds before the king ran off and the storm returned
• according to the king he in services of the 'One True God' who beckoned him as a great hunter and leader of men to undertake an Eternal hunt and protect the realm of man from the greatest of threats (no proof at time)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The Mythology of the Wild Hunt, their purpose and the containment procedures. since a storm cannot be contained the foundation use entertainment media (online flash sales of media/ games, putting popular shows on tv, using media to exaggerate severity of storm). those outside during the storms are written off as casualties of the storm.

Additional Notes: what is the term for a mind controlling or luring component of an SCP? I’m fairly sure I have heard of it before but cannot remember the term.
